scoring_justification: Static dielectric constant and first epsilon2 peak are recomputed from dielectric_function.csv via Kramers-Kronig integration and compared to paper reference values. Structural and band gap are compared directly to paper gold with tolerances. The recompute tier is achieved because the main load-bearing optical quantity is recomputed from the raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference structural parameters, band gaps, static dielectric constants and first epsilon2 peaks from the paper for undoped KTaO3 and Sb-defect1/Sb-defect2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Table 1, Table 2, Fig. 6/7 captions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own results; used as gold for comparison.

outputs.description: Fitted structural parameters from Murnaghan equation of state for undoped KTaO3, Sb-defect1, and Sb-defect2.
Electronic band gaps extracted from total density of states.

Imaginary part of dielectric function ε2(ω) over 0–10 eV. The verifier will recompute static dielectric constant via Kramers-Kronig and compare the value and first peak position against hidden references.

output_contract.notes: Tolerances are set to accommodate systematic differences between DFT codes and pseudopotentials.
